264: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
265: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
266: 	}

268: 	/**
269: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
270: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
271: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
272: 	 */
273: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
274: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
275: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
276: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
277: 		
278: 		if (isExpression) {
279: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
280: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
281: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
282: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
283: 			
284: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
285: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
286: 			Name name = null;
287: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
288: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
289: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
290: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
291: 			}
292: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
293: 			
294: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
295: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
296: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
297: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
298: 		}
299: 		
300: 		if (isIf) {
301: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
302: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
303: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
304: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
305: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
306: 				then = stats.get(0);
307: 			}
308: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
309: 		}
310: 		
311: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
312: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
313: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
314: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
315: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
316: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
317: 			if (isIf) {
318: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
319: 			} else {
320: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
321: 			}
322: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
323: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
324: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
325: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
326: 		}
